notebook_normalization.description: Concatenate the two highLum response rows; subtract their joint mean and divide by joint population standard deviation (NumPy default ddof0). Notebook later reverses plotting sign. This audit applies none of these transformations.

pulse_timing.paper: 20-ms flashes,500-ms gray interleave,121s per field of view
pulse_timing.notebook: Nonzero input at Python samples[2:5]; three time-grid intervals imply25ms on this grid, beginning nominally16.6667ms. This is a discretized model input, not measured photodiode timing. Resolve bin alignment before reproduction claims.

luminance_labels.description: Filenames say highLum/lowLum, but files omit absolute luminance, fly/ROI grouping and source record IDs. Do not assume high/low means ON/OFF contrast or independent biological cohorts.

notebook_integrity: Selection assertion uses a Python boolean expression yielding a single allowed label rather than the intended two-label list.
Time vector statements refer to undefined natsti_res/natsti_res2 variables.
Loaded lowLum response is subsequently overwritten with highLum row0; fitting then uses both highLum contrast rows.

limits: No response curve values redistributed in this inventory.
No independent cells,biological flies,SEM or confidence intervals exist in these files.
Two luminance filenames are not evidence of independent biological replication.
No trial-level held-out split is possible from aggregate mean curves alone.
These descriptors do not validate the graded57cell model or whole-CNS vision.
